coverage: clean directory passes with scanned scope
blocked extension (.exe) fails closed with policy-violation message
PE executable header (MZ) on a non-blocked extension fails closed
clean git-tracked repository passes with tracked scope
nested-directory files are counted by the fallback scan
main gate keeps its existing success/failure contract on 524 tracked paths

limitations: Self-test validates gate logic only; it is not physical artifact signing, driver, or delivery evidence.
Synthetic cases run in a temp directory outside the repository and write no repository files, compiled artifacts, endpoint identity, or private paths.
If git is unavailable, the tracked-scope case falls back to the scanned path, which is still exercised by other cases.
